description: This PHP file defines the ViewBackups class, which manages the backup functionality in the administration module of the SuiteCRM (a fork of SugarCRM). It includes methods for displaying the backup interface, handling backup creation requests, and ensuring proper access control.

classes.name: ViewBackups
classes.description: A class extending SugarView, providing functionality to display and process backup operations within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM administration interface.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates the module title parameters for breadcrumb navigation, including a link to the administration index and the backups title.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Performs access control checks to ensure the current user is an administrator and backups are not hidden by configuration.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the display of the backup interface, processes backup creation requests, performs validation, and displays success or error messages.
